## Faerie Seer (CR 7)

**XP** 3,200  
 N Medium fey  
 **Init** +2; **Senses** blindsight; Perception +3; **Aura** aura of unraveled fate (20 ft.; DC 19)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 20, touch 13, flat-footed 16 (+7 deflection, +2 Dex, +1 dodge)  
 **hp** 90 (10d6+30)  
 **Fort** +5; **Ref** +11; **Will** +12  
 **DR** 5/cold iron  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
 **Melee** mwk dagger +6 (1d4; 19-20/x2)  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 10th; concentration +??)  

  
  Constant—comprehend languages, detect magic, detect thoughts (DC 16)  
 3/day—contact other plane, detect scrying, scrying (DC 19)  
 1/day—divination, legend lore  

  
 **Spells Known** (CL 6th; concentration +??)  

  
  3rd (4/day)—clairaudience/clairvoyance  
 2nd (6/day)—locate object, see invisibility  
 1st (7/day)—detect undead, identify, sleep (DC 15), true strike  
 0th (at will)—arcane mark, daze (DC 14), detect poison, ghost sound, light, read magic  

  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 10, **Dex** 14, **Con** 16, **Int** 18, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 19  
 **Base Atk** +5; **CMB** +5; **CMD** 17  
 **Feats** Ability Focus (aura of unraveled fate), Ability Focus (scrying), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Combat Casting, Skill Focus (knowledge (history))  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility.*  
 **Skills** Bluff +17, Diplomacy +17, Knowledge (arcana) +17, Knowledge (history) +20, Knowledge (nature) +17, Knowledge (the planes) +17, Knowledge (religion) +17, Linguistics +17, Perform (oratory) +17, Spellcraft +17  
 **Languages** Aquan, Auran, Common, Draconic, Elven, Gnome, Halfling, Ignan, Sylvan, Terran  

**Special Abilities**

 **Aura of Unraveled Fate (Su)** A faerie seer stands outside the fabric of time. As such, the area around him is in constant flux as a myriad of possible futures exist within the same space and are constantly competing for dominance. Attack rolls made within the aura must be rolled twice and the attacker must take the lower of the two results. A Will save DC 19 can be made to avoid this effect.  

**Ecology**

**Environment** temperate forests  
 **Organization** solitary  
 **Treasure** standard (masterwork dagger plus other treasure)
